system.description: When you negotiate the terms of a job, roll Edge.

success.value:
Choose 3 from the list below:
• the employer provides useful information [intel]
• the employer provides useful assets [gear]
• the job pays well
• the meeting doesn't attract attention
• the employer is identifiable

partial.value:
Choose 1 from the list below:
• the employer provides useful information [intel]
• the employer provides useful assets [gear]
• the job pays well
• the meeting doesn't attract attention
• the employer is identifiable
